```{r setup}
# Load necessary packages
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)

# ---- Paths & labels ----
results_dir <- "Z:/Projects/EMA_Project/Scripts/Output/Multiverse_Combined_Results"

outcomes <- c(
  "NA" = "Negative Affect",
  "PA" = "Positive Affect",
  "ST" = "Stress"
)

strategies <- c(
  "RP" = "Reappraisal",
  "SP" = "Suppression",
  "DS" = "Distraction",
  "SA" = "Selective Attention",
  "SS" = "Situation Selection"
)

block_labels <- c("multi" = "Joint", "single" = "Independent")

# Y-axis ranges 
ylims_main  <- c(-0.4, 0.8)    # joint (second-order) figure
ylims_indep <- c(-0.4, 0.8)    # independent figure
ylims_nocov <- c(-0.4, 0.8)   # no-covariate figures

# Add an "n points outside y-axis range" subtitle to any panel that drops points
annotate_out_of_range <- TRUE

# ---- Read every CSV once ----
read_block <- function(outcome, strategy, block) {
  fp <- file.path(results_dir, paste0(outcome, "_", strategy, "_", block, ".csv"))
  df <- read.csv(fp, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df$Outcome  <- outcome
  df$Strategy <- strategy
  df$Block    <- block
  df$Sig      <- df$Lower > 0 | df$Upper < 0
  df
}

file_grid <- expand.grid(
  outcome  = names(outcomes),
  strategy = names(strategies),
  block    = names(block_labels),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

all_data <- pmap_dfr(file_grid, read_block)

# ---- Specification parsing (vectorised) ----
parse_specification <- function(spec) {
  tibble(
    Proportion             = as.integer(grepl("Proportion", spec)),
    Pearson                = as.integer(grepl("Pearson", spec)),
    Spearman               = as.integer(grepl("Spearman", spec)),
    Euclid                 = as.integer(grepl("Euclid", spec)),
    Pairwise               = as.integer(grepl("Pairwise", spec)),
    Entropy                = as.integer(grepl("_Entropy", spec) & !grepl("No_Entropy", spec)),
    More_Than_10_Responses = as.integer(grepl("More_Than_10_Responses|MT10R_AND_MT20S", spec)),
    More_Than_20_Seconds   = as.integer(grepl("More_Than_20_Seconds|MT10R_AND_MT20S", spec)),
    Start_Date             = as.integer(grepl("Start_Date|Date_and_Time", spec)),
    Response_Window        = as.integer(grepl("Response_Window|Date_and_Time", spec)),
    Demographics           = as.integer(grepl("_Demographics", spec) & !grepl("No_Demographics", spec)),
    Baseline_ER            = as.integer(grepl("_Baseline_ER", spec) & !grepl("No_Baseline_ER", spec))
  )
}

covariate_dims <- c("Entropy", "Start_Date", "Response_Window", "Demographics", "Baseline_ER")

contains_covariate <- function(spec) {
  rowSums(parse_specification(spec)[, covariate_dims]) > 0
}

spec_levels <- c(
  ">10_Resp", ">20_Sec", "Proportion",
  "Pearson", "Spearman", "Euclid", "Pairwise",
  "Entropy", "Start_Date", "Resp_Wind", "Demographics", "Baseline_ER"
)

spec_colors <- c(
  ">10_Resp" = "firebrick", ">20_Sec" = "firebrick",
  "Proportion" = "steelblue",
  "Pearson" = "seagreen", "Spearman" = "seagreen", "Euclid" = "seagreen",
  "Pairwise" = "darkgoldenrod",
  "Entropy" = "sienna", "Start_Date" = "sienna", "Resp_Wind" = "sienna",
  "Demographics" = "sienna", "Baseline_ER" = "sienna"
)

# ---- Plot builders ----
create_coefficient_plot <- function(data, title, ylims, title_size = 44) {
  data$Color <- ifelse(data$Sig, "green3", "tomato")
  n <- nrow(data)

  in_range <- !is.na(data$Parameter) &
    data$Parameter >= ylims[1] & data$Parameter <= ylims[2]
  n_out <- sum(!is.na(data$Parameter) & !in_range)

  subtitle <- if (annotate_out_of_range && n_out > 0) {
    paste0(n_out, " of ", n, " point", ifelse(n_out == 1, "", "s"),
           " outside y-axis range (not shown)")
  } else NULL

  ggplot(data[in_range, ], aes(x = Index, y = Parameter)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = Color), size = 4, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 2) +
    scale_color_identity() +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = ylims) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.5, n + 0.5)) +   # keeps alignment with the spec heatmap
    labs(title = title, subtitle = subtitle, x = "", y = "Beta Coefficient") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 6) +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(size = title_size, hjust = 0.2, face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 28, hjust = 0.2, face = "italic"),
      axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y  = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x  = element_text(size = 1),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

create_specification_plot <- function(data) {
  n <- nrow(data)

  long_data <- parse_specification(data$Specification) %>%
    mutate(Index = data$Index) %>%
    pivot_longer(-Index, names_to = "Variable", values_to = "Value") %>%
    mutate(
      Variable = recode(Variable,
                        More_Than_10_Responses = ">10_Resp",
                        More_Than_20_Seconds   = ">20_Sec",
                        Response_Window        = "Resp_Wind"),
      Variable = factor(Variable, levels = spec_levels),
      Fill     = ifelse(Value == 1L, as.character(Variable), NA_character_)
    )

  ggplot(long_data, aes(x = Index, y = Variable, fill = Fill)) +
    geom_tile(height = 0.8) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = spec_colors, na.value = "white", guide = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.5, n + 0.5)) +
    labs(x = "Specification", y = "Analytic Dimension") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 8) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 30, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 34, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position  = "none"
    )
}

# One panel = coefficient plot over spec heatmap (rows kept in file order, as before)
make_panel <- function(data, title, ylims, title_size = 44) {
  data <- data %>% mutate(Index = row_number())
  create_coefficient_plot(data, title, ylims, title_size) /
    create_specification_plot(data) +
    plot_layout(heights = c(2, 1))
}

# One outcome row = five strategy panels
make_outcome_row <- function(data, outcome, block, ylims, fig_title,
                             panel_title_size = 44, fig_title_size = 54) {
  panels <- lapply(names(strategies), function(s) {
    d <- data %>% filter(Outcome == outcome, Strategy == s, Block == block)
    make_panel(d, paste0(outcome, " and ", strategies[[s]]), ylims, panel_title_size)
  })
  wrap_plots(panels, ncol = 5, guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
      title = fig_title,
      theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = fig_title_size, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
    )
}
```

# Joint (second-order) multiverse

```{r joint-figure}
final_plot_na <- make_outcome_row(all_data, "NA", "multi", ylims_main,
                                  "Second-Order Multiverse Analysis: Negative Affect (NA)")
final_plot_pa <- make_outcome_row(all_data, "PA", "multi", ylims_main,
                                  "Second-Order Multiverse Analysis: Positive Affect (PA)")
final_plot_st <- make_outcome_row(all_data, "ST", "multi", ylims_main,
                                  "Second-Order Multiverse Analysis: Stress (ST)")

final_plot_all <- final_plot_na / final_plot_pa / final_plot_st +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Second-Order Multiverse Analysis",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 64, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")),
    tag_levels = "a"
  )

ggsave(
  filename = "second_order_multiverse_analysis.png",
  plot = final_plot_all,
  width = 60,
  height = 60,
  dpi = 300,
  limitsize = FALSE
)
```

In text results
```{r intext-results}
results_summary <- all_data %>%
  group_by(Outcome, Block, Strategy) %>%
  summarise(
    Total = n(),
    Sig   = sum(Sig, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Block    = ifelse(Block == "multi", "Joint", "Single"),
    Outcome  = factor(Outcome,  levels = names(outcomes)),
    Strategy = factor(Strategy, levels = names(strategies)),
    Percent  = round(100 * Sig / Total, 3)
  ) %>%
  arrange(Block, Outcome, Strategy)

print(results_summary, n = Inf)
```

```{r intext-strategy-count}
# Helper: parse a shared spec id by removing "<Outcome>_<Strategy>_" and ".csv"
parse_spec_id <- function(spec, outcome, strategy) {
  spec |>
    sub("\\.csv$", "", x = _) |>
    sub(paste0("^", outcome, "_", strategy, "_"), "", x = _)
}

# Core: for an outcome ("NA", "PA", "ST"), count how many strategies are significant per spec (joint models)
get_significance_summary <- function(outcome) {
  wide <- all_data %>%
    filter(Outcome == outcome, Block == "multi") %>%
    mutate(spec_id = parse_spec_id(Specification, outcome, Strategy)) %>%
    distinct(spec_id, Strategy, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    select(spec_id, Strategy, Sig) %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = spec_id, names_from = Strategy, values_from = Sig,
                values_fill = FALSE)

  present <- intersect(names(strategies), names(wide))
  wide <- wide %>%
    mutate(
      Outcome = outcome,
      Num_Significant_Strategies = rowSums(across(all_of(present)), na.rm = TRUE)
    )

  total_specs <- nrow(wide)

  distribution <- wide %>%
    count(Outcome, Num_Significant_Strategies, name = "Num_Specifications") %>%
    complete(
      Outcome = outcome,
      Num_Significant_Strategies = 0:5,
      fill = list(Num_Specifications = 0)
    ) %>%
    mutate(Percent = round(100 * Num_Specifications / total_specs, 3)) %>%
    arrange(Outcome, Num_Significant_Strategies)

  list(
    by_spec = wide %>% arrange(spec_id),
    distribution = distribution
  )
}

na_res <- get_significance_summary("NA")
pa_res <- get_significance_summary("PA")
st_res <- get_significance_summary("ST")

# Combined distribution table
signif_strategy_distribution <- bind_rows(
  na_res$distribution, pa_res$distribution, st_res$distribution
)

print(signif_strategy_distribution, n = Inf)
```

--NO COVARIATES--
```{r no-covariates}
nocov_data <- all_data %>%
  filter(Block == "multi", !contains_covariate(Specification))

nocov_fig_title_size <- c("NA" = 50, "PA" = 40, "ST" = 40)
nocov_files <- c(
  "NA" = "negative_affect_analysis_no_covariate.png",
  "PA" = "positive_affect_analysis_no_covariate.png",
  "ST" = "stress_analysis_no_covariate.png"
)

for (o in names(outcomes)) {
  p <- make_outcome_row(
    nocov_data, o, "multi", ylims_nocov,
    fig_title        = paste0(outcomes[[o]], " (", o, ") Multiverse Analysis\n(no covariate specifications)"),
    panel_title_size = 38,
    fig_title_size   = nocov_fig_title_size[[o]]
  )
  ggsave(
    filename = nocov_files[[o]],
    plot = p,
    width = 52,
    height = 20,
    dpi = 300,
    limitsize = FALSE
  )
}
```
